messages:
support-elaine: FYI MaplePay (dedicated tenant) reports repeated 429s this morning, says instances are "flickering" — scale up/down every ~3m :rotating_light:
cs-jordan: Customer ticket #3912 includes request_ids and sample timestamps, pasted them into the ticket. they say impact started ~08:50 UTC.
oncall-lee: looking now. I see a bursty pattern on maple-dedicated-1 pool — many scale decisions in short window. tagging eng.
eng-raj: can you dump the autoscaler decision log for that timeframe? need reasons/metrics.
oncall-lee: pasted snippet from autoscaler API (09:15–09:22 UTC):
```
2025-06-12T09:15:12Z scale_up from 2->6 reason=queue_len>100 moving_avg=110
2025-06-12T09:18:14Z scale_down from 6->3 reason=cpu<20 moving_avg=18
2025-06-12T09:21:16Z scale_up from 3->7 reason=queue_len>120 moving_avg=125
2025-06-12T09:24:10Z scale_down from 7->2 reason=cpu<15 moving_avg=12
```
eng-maya: that pattern looks classic: short queue spikes trigger up, then fast CPU drop makes us shrink too quickly -> oscillation. What's current cooldown/stabilization?
sre-tim: config for maple-dedicated-1: cooldown_sec=120, stabilization_window_sec=60, smoothing_type=none, downscale_cpu_threshold=25.
eng-raj: 120s cooldown is too short for a bursty workload. proposal: tenant-level policy hack to reduce flapping: cooldown_sec=300, add exponential smoothing over 300s moving window for queue_len, and block downscale if there was a scale_up within last 600s.
oncall-lee: can we apply just for maple-dedicated-1 as a canary? customer is high-impact.
eng-maya: yes, we have per-tenant override flags. I'll push a canary config: cooldown=300, smoothing_window=300, downscale_block_after_up_sec=600.
autoscale-bot: Deploy triggered by eng-maya for maple-dedicated-1 at commit abc123. CI checks passed.
support-elaine: notified customer that we're applying a tuned policy and to expect improved stability within ~15m. asked for fresh logs if 429s persist.
cs-jordan: Customer replied: still seeing occasional 429s but frequency much lower. will keep us posted.
oncall-lee: metrics after canary (09:40–09:55): scale_events_per_hour dropped 18 -> 4, average queue_len spike amplitude reduced. keeping watch for 30m.
eng-raj: also recommended hotfix: add a small grace period to the request router to attempt 1 retry with jitter on 429s for dedicated tenants during scaling. reduces surface area for rapid retries causing backpressure. Add to runbook.
sre-tim: opened INC-2025-4321, assigned to eng-raj for follow-up and postmortem. added telemetry dashboard for maple-dedicated-1 with moving_avg(queue_len,300s) and last_scale_event_age.
eng-maya: will leave canary for 2 hours; if stable we'll roll to other pools. I also scheduled a short experiment to test warmup prefetch of KV cache on scale up to reduce cold-start latency.
support-elaine: thanks all :thumbsup: 
eng-raj: one more note — long term we should add hysteresis to downscale (downscale only if metric below threshold for X consecutive windows) and consider fractional scaling (scale by % instead of discrete jumps) to avoid big swings. putting on next sprint.
oncall-lee: agreed. close loop after postmortem.
support-elaine: customer confirmed degraded experience largely resolved; will update ticket when fully green.
